{{Quote|Ungrateful little rat thinks he's too good for us now.|[[Talos Drellik]], quoting his father on his brother|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
The '''brother''' of [[Talos Drellik]] was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]; he was personally selected by the [[Dark Council]]or [[Darth Marr]] to enter the [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Sith Academy]], losing all contact with his family. This greatly irritated [[Drellik|his father]], as well as his brother, Talos.
